Hi I am Cai!
I am a University of Alberta student interested in finance, data, algorithmic trading, and building systems that improve over time

title: My Website
text:
Background
My intial exposure to coding came in the form of game scripting where I used Lua to tweak small mechanics within game systems to automate them. That exposure reall taught me to think about how environments and rules can interact.

title: My Website
text:
What I am Learning Now
Recently I have been learning about Linux-Based environments outside of school and exploring new programming languages to help with algorithmic trading. I am currently attempting to learn Ocaml, to really push myself into new areas.

title: My Website
text:
Beyond Just Coding
Outside of coding and technical work I find myself enjoying gardening, running and speaking with new people with new ideas who bring all different kinds of strenghths to the table

text:
What Drives me and Where I Hope To Be
What motivates me most is gaining new knowledge and being able to see the progress that is rewarded after finding solutions to problems I had prior. I am not sure exactly what specific area of finance I want to work in, however I am interested in always exploring new oppurtunities in different sectors!
